c.j. stroud.note: 22.3 fantasy points a game over his last three, Week 7 vs the Giants. PFF's top QB add — rostered in Kenny's league.

dameon pierce.note: 87% of snaps in Week 6 — and 49 rushing yards on 23 attempts since Week 5. Barkley's return window opens in Week 7. A one-week rental whose week may already be over.

demario douglas.note: RotoWire's #2 WR add at 8%. Back-to-back big games and Doubs' shoulder (est. Week 7-12) keeps his role open. New England plays Thursday — instant Week 7 starter.

dylan sampson.note: CLE garbage offense — excluded by Kenny's rule. Also a three-way backfield split with Judkins and Sampson both possibly back for Week 7.

germie bernard.note: The consensus #1 add of Week 7 (RotoWire 18% FAAB, Athletic $14) — but rostered in Kenny's league by thanos4ever. The 1.83 aDOT slot profile and Pittman's return in ~2 games cap the runway even where he is available.

j.j. mccarthy.note: 243 yards and a TD in a quarter of relief — against a Saints defense protecting a 24-point lead. Week 7 starter not yet named, and it's at Houston followed by a bye.

ja'kobi lane.note: Devontez Walker, not Lane, took the WR2 snaps when Bateman went down — and Lane's value needs Lamar Jackson, who hasn't practiced since Week 4.

jaleel mclaughlin.note: Led Cleveland in touches in Week 6 — in the muddiest backfield of the week, on a banned offense. Kenny owns the starter he's filling in for.

jaylin noel.note: Real player, squeezed role. WR11 over his 3-game streak with elite efficiency, but the role never grew (<=5 targets, ~61% routes) and Week 7 adds Dell (active) plus a ramping Harrison to the room. Bye in Week 8. Boom stash at $3, not a bankable starter.

jonah coleman.note: Eligible off IR for Week 7 at Arizona; Denver's backs are averaging 3.3 and 3.9 a carry in front of him. Rostered in Kenny's league (Guru Njigba).

jonathon brooks.note: Carolina IR stash sitting on Kenny's wire at 43% rostered. Kenny's IR is full, so he's a stash for somebody else's roster.

jordan mason.note: RotoBaller's #1 overall add — IR return into a split with Aaron Jones. Rostered in Kenny's league by The Third Reichard, his Week 7 opponent.

jordyn tyson.note: Hamstring return est. Week 7-9 with a multi-week runway. Rostered in Kenny's league (Guru Njigba).

kc concepcion jr..note: PFF and RotoBaller both like the rookie — and he's a Brown, which ends the discussion under Kenny's rule, whatever the rankers say.

keenan allen.note: 9+ targets in three straight, 11 in Week 6, with Pierce on IR. Floor play with a capped ceiling; Daniel Jones' Week 6 wobble and Tyler Warren's return are the watch items. Rostered in Kenny's league.

kendre miller.note: Started over a dinged Kamara and led New Orleans in Week 6 (20 carries, 22 touches). Kamara stays in the rotation and Etienne returns after the Week 8 bye. Rostered in Kenny's league — he traded Miller there himself.

kenny gainwell.note: Highest-owned available RB on Kenny's wire (49%) with zero analyst push behind him. Committee profile — ownership is not a role.

keon coleman.note: Available on Kenny's wire at 31% rostered, but Buffalo is on bye in Week 7 and no outlet pushed him this week. A name in search of a role.

kyler murray.note: Available on Kenny's wire and a legitimate QB1-talent streamer. Kenny starts Mahomes, so this is a note for the league, not a move for him.

michael mayer.note: 23 targets over his last four games with three 10+ PPR weeks — RotoWire's TE add at 2%. Available on Kenny's wire, but Kenny starts Trey McBride.

omar cooper jr..note: Consensus #2 overall add and the best player actually on Kenny's wire. One-game sample is the whole risk — RotoWire bid 0% and said pump the brakes; The Athletic bid $10. Talent and the WR2 snap share (51 of 62) say pay it.

quentin johnston.note: Re-graded D on Oct 18: 7 catches on 19 targets (37%) through four games. Opportunity without production — don't add even free.

roschon johnson.note: Swift is limping and Monangai is out until about Week 8-9 — the role is real for a week or two. Rostered in Kenny's league (Guru Njigba).

samaje perine.note: RotoWire's own warning: do not expect a changing of the guard over Chase Brown. Kenny already bought and sold this ticket once.

tank dell.note: Activated for Week 7 vs the Giants (confirmed Oct 19) — first game in 22 months, light snap count expected, Week 8 bye behind it. If the ramp makes him Houston's #2 by November, he's the best stash on this wire. Costs a bench spot now that he's active.

tanner mckee.note: Philadelphia's starter for the rest of the season with Hurts out (blood clots). 45 attempts in Week 6. Deep-league and superflex relevance only.

travis hunter.note: The breakout buzz rests on Brian Thomas Jr.'s second-half benching — but Hunter played 9 offensive snaps. Jacksonville is on bye in Week 7. Stash in IDP leagues only.

tyjae spears.note: Best available RB stash on Kenny's wire. Passing-down role in Tennessee; the offense caps the floor, the contingency is the value.

tyler higbee.note: Season-high 83% snap share in Week 6, and Davante Adams' leg injury could push targets his way. Stream-tier TE.

tyrone tracy jr..note: Two touchdowns on eight touches in the league's most chaotic backfield. Touchdown rate is not a role.

math_top5.name: Jordan Mason
math_top5.why: RotoBaller's overall tool ranks him #1 for Week 7 — the IR-return back (thumb, out since Week 1) walks back into Minnesota's early-down and goal-line split with Aaron Jones. No published FAAB: he's rostered in most leagues, including Kenny's (The Third Reichard).

math_top5.name: Germie Bernard
math_top5.why: The strongest consensus on the board: #1 at three outlets. 21 targets in two games with Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR — 11 catches, 87 yards and the OT winner in Week 6. Rostered in Kenny's league (thanos4ever), so the math loves a player his wire doesn't have.

math_top5.name: Kyler Murray
math_top5.why: Last Word on Sports' #3 overall add. Minnesota's starter is the rare waiver QB with genuine QB1 talent — a streamer who can become a hold. Actually available on Kenny's wire, for whatever a Mahomes owner needs with that.

math_top5.name: Jordyn Tyson
math_top5.why: RotoBaller's tool has him #5 overall. The Saints' rookie is returning from a hamstring injury (est. Week 7-9) with a multi-week runway once he's active. Rostered in Kenny's league (Guru Njigba).

math_top5.name: Keenan Allen
math_top5.why: 9+ targets in three straight games (11 in Week 6) with Alec Pierce on IR keeping his share propped up. The floor play of the week — capped ceiling, bankable volume. Rostered in Kenny's league.

method: Analyst picks = AI determination: multi-source Week 7 consensus filtered against Kenny's actual Yahoo wire and his no-Dolphins/no-Browns rule. The pure fair-average top 5 is preserved verbatim in math_top5 (no rulebook cuts applied to it).

picks.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
sources: Analyst consensus avg 8.25 (dragged by one tool ranking; top-2 at three outlets)
picks.why: The top add actually available on this wire. First-round rookie who returned from a 4-game IR stint and immediately ran as the Jets' WR2 next to Garrett Wilson — 51 of 62 snaps, team-high targets, 6 catches for 103 yards and a TD. Consensus #2 overall add (FantasyPros, USA Today, Last Word on Sports) and The Athletic's second-biggest bid of the week at $10. The risk is the sample size: exactly one game.

picks.name: DeMario Douglas
picks.why: Back-to-back big games (7 catches, 86 yards, TD in Week 6) and Romeo Doubs' shoulder injury — an estimated Week 7-12 return window — opens New England's target tree further. RotoWire's #2 WR add at 8% of budget. Bonus: the Patriots play Thursday in Week 7, so he's a starter the moment he clears.

picks.name: Tank Dell
sources: AI determination — IR-R stash, return est. Week 7-9
On waivers, IR-R — clears Oct 21 (verified Oct 20)
picks.why: Activated for Week 7 vs the Giants (confirmed Oct 19) — his first game in 22 months, with a light snap count expected and a Week 8 bye right behind it. The ramp is the bet: Collins is the alpha and Harrison is being force-fed, but if Dell reclaims a top-2 role by November he's the best stash on this wire. He's active now, so he costs a bench spot, not an IR slot.

picks.name: Tyjae Spears
picks.why: The best running-back stash on this wire — Tennessee's passing-down back, one Pollard development away from a real role. The offense caps his weekly floor, so this is a bench hold with contingent upside, not a Week 7 start.

picks.name: Jaylin Noel
sources: USA Today #4, Last Word on Sports #8
picks.why: Three straight 10+ half-PPR games with elite efficiency (2.69 yards per route, 14 straight catches) — on a capped role: never more than 5 targets, about 61% of routes, snaps flat. The squeeze lands in Week 7 with Dell active and Harrison drawing 4 targets on 12 snaps in his debut, and Houston's bye is Week 8. A cheap boom stash, not a starter.
